name: AI Coding Agent Rules Starter Pack
six_word_summary: Production guardrails for AI coding agents
what: MIT-licensed coding-agent rule files and task templates focused on verification, security, minimal diffs and safer tool use.
where: Source-controlled software projects using Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI or compatible coding agents.
when: Copied into a repository as AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor MDC rules or reusable task/review templates.
why: Reduce unrelated refactors, missing verification, secret exposure and unsafe tool or migration behavior.
with: Plain Markdown, MDC and repository-native instruction files; no runtime dependency or signup.
watch: Individual-maintained public GitHub resource. Free starter files are MIT licensed. No executable installer, credentials, network calls or background processes are required.
